title: Slideomatic Field Guide
subtitle: Voice-powered presentations, built in the browser

headline: This deck is the manual
body: Arrow keys move between slides. Press `?` to see every keyboard shortcut.
Each slide walks you through a feature—read it, try it. Nothing saves to a server; all edits live in your browser until you export.

pillars.title: Create
pillars.text: Press **V** and describe a slide. Gemini turns your voice into a fully structured slide with the right layout.

pillars.title: Edit
pillars.text: Record while on any slide to edit it by voice—change the headline, swap the layout, add bullet points.

pillars.title: Theme
pillars.text: Voice-generate an entire theme. Say “vaporwave neon” or “minimal paper” and watch the palette change live.

pillars.title: Images
pillars.text: AI decides whether to search stock photos or generate an illustration, then fills the placeholder automatically.

headline: Add your Gemini API key
body: Press **S** to open Settings. Paste your Gemini API key and hit **Save Key**. Use **Test Connection** to verify it works.
Get a free key at [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Your key stays in your browser—it never touches our servers.
All voice and AI features (slide generation, theme generation, image AI) require this key. Everything else works without it.

headline: Press **E** to edit anything
body: **Content** tab: titles, body text, badges, quotes, captions. Type and click out to auto-save.
**Layouts** tab: swap this slide to quote, gallery, pillars, split, or any other type. Add new slides already styled.
**Media** tab: upload images, compress them, add captions. Also home to the SomaFM radio and **Download PDF** button.

left.headline: Left side
left.body: Split slides are great for comparisons, before/after, or pairing an image with text. Each column stands on its own.

right.headline: Right side
right.body: Use the edit drawer to fill each column independently. Split is one of 10 available slide types.

headline: Keep the rhythm weird
body: Standard, quote, gallery, pillars, typeface, split, grid, image—all one click away in the Layouts tab.

headline: Fonts are mood swings
body: Override the `font` field per-slide when you need a different voice mid-deck.

caption: Leave `image.src` empty but keep the `alt` text to unlock the AI image button while presenting.

headline: Press **T** whenever the vibe feels stale
body: Theme drawer lets you randomize palettes, tweak layer styles, and save presets. Everything updates live.
SomaFM radio pipes curated streams straight into the drawer so you can design with a soundtrack.
With a Gemini API key, hit the wand icon to AI-generate themes from a text description—or use voice.

headline: Keep these in your fingers
body: **E** = edit drawer, **T** = themes, **V** = voice, **S** = settings, **O** = overview grid.
**D** downloads the deck as JSON. **U** uploads one. **N** toggles speaker notes.
`Shift + Arrow` skips five slides. `Option/Alt + Arrow` duplicates the current slide.
`?` opens the full cheat sheet any time you forget.

pillars.title: JSON
pillars.text: **D** downloads the deck. **U** uploads one. The JSON format is portable—edit it by hand or share it.

pillars.title: PDF
pillars.text: Hit **Download PDF** in the edit drawer to export a printable version of your slides.

pillars.title: Local stash
pillars.text: Decks autosave to your browser's localStorage. Clear them in devtools if you need a clean slate.

pillars.title: Share
pillars.text: Use the share feature to create a link anyone can view—no account required.

quote: Ship the weird draft. Future you can clean it up.

headline: Treat Slideomatic like a sketchbook
body: Duplicate this deck, tear it apart, swap in your own chaos. It’s yours.
Try the voice features—press **V** and describe a slide. It’s the fastest way to build.
Have fun, keep it human, keep it moving.
